problem_statement: Nutlope/qrGPT (rebranded here as Glyphwright, a small studio that renders custom AI QR-art from a short prompt) is a Next.js 13 App Router + Tailwind + shadcn/ui application with a home route '/', a generator route '/start' with a prompt/URL form and prompt-suggestion pills, and a studio route '/studio'. The product adds a 'Style studio' preset browser — a filterable gallery of QR-art style preset cards (each seeds the generator prompt) with a category filter (All / Landscape / Ink / Neon) and a live readout 'Showing N of 6 · <category>'. Three things are in scope. (1) The Style studio must greet visitors on EVERY core surface — the generator (/start), the home landing (/), and the studio page (/studio) — as a consistent, on-brand neutral-gray preset browser, not just the page you happen to edit. (2) The category filter must update its readout live: clicking Ink must both filter the cards to the two Ink presets AND update the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Ink' (it reads 'Showing 6 of 6 · All' before the click). (3) A QA pass on a 390px phone found the /start screen scrolls sideways because the browser's category tab row is pinned to a fixed 720px non-wrapping width with fixed 168px tabs and a fixed three-column card grid, dragging the whole document into horizontal overflow. Mount the Style studio consistently across the three routes, wire the category filter so the readout reflects the selected category, and repair the browser so it reflows to fit a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow — all while keeping the generator form, home content, and studio copy unchanged, and the app building with next build and running offline with no console or network errors.
required_content: The 'Style studio' preset browser is present on all three routes (home '/', generator '/start', and studio '/studio') as an on-brand neutral-gray card headed 'Style studio', carrying its category tabs (All / Landscape / Ink / Neon), the live readout, and the six readable preset cards.

The category filter updates its readout live: after clicking Ink on the /start browser, the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Ink' and only the two Ink preset cards remain (it reads 'Showing 6 of 6 · All' before the click).
The preset cards stay legible on every viewport (readable dark ink on the light card surface, cards laid out without overlapping), matching the Glyphwright neutral-gray design language.

On a 390px mobile viewport the /start screen has no horizontal overflow beyond a small tolerance: the category tab row and card grid reflow to fit the screen instead of forcing the document wider than the viewport; desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) lay out cleanly.

The navbar, hero/home content, generator form (URL + prompt fields, prompt-suggestion pills, Generate button), and studio copy remain present and unchanged; no new console errors or failed network requests are introduced, and the app builds with next build and serves offline with next start.
design_constraints: Preserve the Glyphwright / shadcn-ui design language: neutral gray palette, Tailwind spacing rhythm, rounded card surfaces, and the existing route and section order. The Style studio must read as a native neutral-gray card, not an off-brand or low-contrast surface.
Mount the Style studio from a shared browser component so it appears consistently on all three routes; do not add it to only the route you happen to edit.

The category filter must actually update the readout on click (not merely move the active-tab highlight or re-filter the cards while the readout stays frozen); the post-click readout must reflect the selected category and count.

Repair the browser by letting its category tab row and card grid reflow to fit narrow viewports; do not mask the overflow by clipping the row or hiding overflow at the body/html level. The repair must fit 390px mobile, 834px tablet, and 1440px desktop.
Keep the Next.js App Router build intact — next build must still succeed and next start must still serve the home, generator, and studio routes.
state_constraints: desktop_home / mobile_home / tablet_home capture the home landing at 1440/390/834px; the Style studio browser is present and fits with no horizontal overflow after the change.

desktop_start / tablet_start / mobile_start capture the generator route; with the defect the category tab row forces the document ~346px wider than a 390px viewport, and the repair brings horizontal overflow within tolerance.

desktop_studio_browser and mobile_studio_cards capture the Style studio cards on /start; the cards must stay legible (readable dark ink on light) and reflow tidily on mobile, not turn illegible or overlap.
desktop_home_browser and desktop_studio_page capture the Style studio on the home and studio routes; the browser must be present and consistent on both.
desktop_filter_ink captures the /start browser after clicking the Ink category tab; the readout must read 'Showing 2 of 6 · Ink' (changed from 'Showing 6 of 6 · All').
mobile_studio_cards also confirms the generator form and prompt-suggestion content are unchanged and overflow-free after the change.

change_completion: The Style studio preset browser is present and consistent across all three routes with its category filter wired to update the readout live.
Clicking the Ink category on the /start browser updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Ink' and shows only the two Ink presets.
The mobile /start screen no longer overflows horizontally: the category tab row and card grid reflow to fit a 390px viewport.
design_consistency: The Style studio preserves the Glyphwright neutral-gray identity, readable card typography, and rounded card surfaces across every route.

The browser is mounted uniformly from the shared component (present on all three routes), not added ad hoc to a single page, and its cards stay legible rather than turning near-white-on-white or overlapping.
responsive: At 390px the category tab row wraps and the card grid flexes down so the document width stays within the viewport.
At 834px and 1440px the browser lays out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
regression: Navbar, hero/home content, generator form (URL + prompt fields, prompt-suggestion pills, Generate button), and studio copy remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.

author_notes: Repo-grounded state_continuity task on the Nutlope/qrGPT Next.js 13 App Router QR-art generator (rebranded Glyphwright). L4 with four orthogonal design gates on the app's OWN native control surface — a filterable Style studio preset browser (the generator's own prompt-seed control, a richer version of the prompt-suggestion pills), not a bolted-on metric rail. D6 no_horizontal_overflow (the browser's category tab row is a fixed 720px nowrap track that overflows a 390px phone; reference wraps to 0, baseline ~370px, bad ~346px), D3 visual_regression (the preset cards must stay legible dark-ink-on-light; bad restyles them near-white-on-near-white and shingles them with negative margins so they overlap and become illegible), D2 dom_assertions cross-page (the browser must be present on home + /start + /studio; baseline mounts it on /start only, bad on /start + home only), and D4 interaction_assertions (clicking the Ink category must update the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Ink'; bad's readout was snapshotted at mount so the cards re-filter but the readout stays 'Showing 6 of 6 · All'). The baseline fails D6+D3+D2 but PASSES D4 (its filter is correctly wired), and the bad fails all four. Content and copy are held identical across legs. Offline INFRA identical across all legs: next/font/google Inter replaced by a local system font stack, @vercel/analytics + next-plausible dropped, next/image set unoptimized, and the @vercel/kv share-record read stubbed so the build touches no remote AI/DB/analytics service.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Nutlope/qrGPT is a runnable Next.js 13 App Router + Tailwind + shadcn/ui QR-art generator (rebranded Glyphwright). Its generator route already hosts a prompt-seed control surface (prompt-suggestion pills), which makes it an ideal host for an L4 state-continuity task built on the app's OWN native control: a filterable Style studio preset browser mounted across the home, generator, and studio routes (cross-page consistency, visual legibility, an interactive category filter with a live readout, and a mobile horizontal-overflow repair).
